title: Mushroom & Basil Omelette with Cream Cheese
description: A three-egg omelette filled with sautéed mushrooms, cream cheese and fresh basil.
steps: Sauté the mushrooms in butter for 5-8 minutes until tender.
Beat the eggs with chives and seasoning, then cook in a hot non-stick pan, swirling to set.
Fill with mushrooms, cream cheese and basil, fold in half and serve.

source.label: Adapted from BBC Good Food mushroom & basil omelette

notes: A genuinely low-carb breakfast option for days you want protein without the extra carbs.
